messages:
maya: Starting a 4-bit (q4b) bring-up for long-summarization workloads. Plan: use a labelled-anchor canary (~2k long summaries), dedupe + labeler pass for hallucination flags, then compare int8 baseline -> q4b. Anyone blocking labeler capacity or dedupe infra?

devin: No infra blocks from my side. What's the canary sample query and distribution (size / sources)?

maya: Query: tokenized length >= 4000, source = s3://redwood-curation/longs, target n=2000 (we'll oversample to 2.5k then dedupe). Split: 80/20 eval/train. I'll share the sampling script shortly.

sasha: I can run the dedupe fingerprint sweep. Recommend fuzzyhash v2 + url-normalization + strip-signatures. I'll drop commands.

sasha: ```python tools/sample.py --src longs --min-tokens 4000 --n 2500 --deid true > canary_seed.jsonl```
```./tools/dedupe/fuzzy_v2 --input canary_seed.jsonl --output canary_unique.jsonl --threshold 0.85```

anita: :raising_hand: Label ops here — we have 12 annotators available next week. For 2k docs, propose 200 gold (double-labeled) + 1.8k single-labeled. Need prompt guide + QC heuristics. Any preferences for label taxonomy?

kevin: Eval plan: ROUGE-L + semantic overlap (embed-sim) + hallucination rate (binary from gold). Also compute coherence drift metric (n-gram continuity). Can we run a baseline sweep on current int8 model first?

maya: Baseline int8 (v2026-03) run already queued (job 9876). Expect to finish in ~6h. q4b config: quant_profile=q4b-longctx, kv_cache_max_tokens to emulate 8k window. Watch for drop in long-coherence and hallucination.

labeler-bot: Label queue created: canary_long_q4b_20260122 (2000 docs). 12 annotators assigned. Due date 2026-01-29.

anita: Thanks — I'll draft the prompt guide and circulate. Also reserving 50 docs for spot-checks during rolling canary and 30 for adjudication.

devin: Small infra ask: make sure kv-cache length is actually set to 8192 when running canary so runtime kernel selection mirrors prod longctx behavior. maya, can you pin that?

maya: On it. I'll pin kv_cache_max_tokens=8192 and quant_profile=q4b-longctx for the canary job, and update the rollout doc here once the int8->q4b comparison finishes. :rocket:
